name: Miffy small independent Z head tilt v22 · non-production

headRoll.guide: Existing show-guides switch; pivot and extreme forehead path; default off
headRoll.note: Small candidate tilt only. Idle stance compensation and pointer follow remain unchanged.

limits: Only small Z-axis tilt is enabled; X/Y yaw and pitch, mouth shapes and expressions remain unimplemented.
Head, face, eye overlays and hair follow the same head parent, but long hair and the neck/shoulder boundary need visual review at both tilt extremes.
The ±1.5° bound and [625,220] pivot are review values, not artistically accepted production settings.
